title: Absolution Necromancer

stages.title: Act 1
stages.goal: Use the source’s Act 1 setup until Absolution is available.

stages.title: Act 2
stages.goal: Link Absolution to Minion Damage and Added Lightning Damage.

stages.title: Act 4
stages.goal: Keep upgrading Absolution links. Save Shield Charge and Frostblink for movement.

stages.title: Act 10
stages.goal: Use the campaign gear as a baseline and replace it with life and resistance rares.

stages.title: Absolution Late Maps
stages.goal: Reach red maps on Absolution. The original guide also documents a separate Chains of Command progression.

overview:
Use Kinetic Bolt at the start. Switch to Absolution in Act 1 and keep it through maps. Use a Vaal gem if available.

Source guide by Travic: https://mobalytics.gg/poe/profile/travic/builds/chains-of-command-necromancer-absolution-league-starter
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/-iGZou8aEm2a

Passive trees converted with the 3.30 PoB development build. See the creator guide for assumptions and any additional stages.
